correctness.rationale: For every nonzero x, strict g decrease and d nonincrease give 0<F(x)<Mx on each row, so Perron weight s_t=w^T x_t strictly decreases; boundedness and compactness exclude a positive limit. Taylor expansion F=Mx+B(x_j^2)+o(||x||^2) has B_ij<0 and kappa>0. Positivity/primitive M makes contraction on w-orthogonal complement; z_t/s_t->0. Therefore s_{t+1}-s_t=-kappa s_t^2+o(s_t^2) and reciprocal increments converge to kappa, proving t*x_t->v/kappa. Independently verified the two-patch example kappa=75/49 and target (28/75,7/25); at t=100000 the scaled coordinates were (0.3733219764,0.2799920423), consistent with but not proving the rate.
